classes.name: index
classes.reason: _consume aborts and marks the unit dropped if the running time exceeds the broadcast budget ('if budget_ns and probe.NS() - started > budget_ns: return staged, True'), and every rank is already parked at the preceding barrier.broadcast() and the trailing barrier.wait() so the whole job stalls until that read finishes or times out; each index file is read exactly once per rank in the inner loop of _consume.

classes.name: statistics
classes.reason: _report has no time check and simply loops 'for _pass in range(STATISTICS_READS)' re-reading the same path 8 times synchronously, and because every rank must pass through the same barrier.wait() at the end of the unit loop, producers and idle ranks sit idle until the consumer's 8 statistics reads complete, coupling the whole job without any deadline pressure.
